zh.summary: 改进 Windows 启动、便携语言设置和工作区稳定性，继续使用已验收的 rc.5 内核。
highlights: Windows ZIP 预备运行环境，减少首次启动的重复准备；共享日志被占用时保留每次启动的诊断记录。
Portable 的菜单、托盘、更新和维护界面跟随官方语言设置；启动主题读取官方设置的初始值。
修复会话列表可能不显示的问题；Windows 任务栏和托盘使用随系统配色变化的实心鲸鱼标志。
插件发现和管理使用官方界面，新环境不再自动添加社区索引。现有索引仍可使用。
修复依赖缓存和旧运行记录整理时遇到链接或占用文件的处理，并改进启动共享文件冲突的提示。
upgradeNotes: 正常退出后更新。新包内置 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5；可在内核更新中另行选择已验收版本。
需要社区插件目录时，按 README 将索引添加到官方「发现」。

en.summary: Improves Windows startup, Portable language support, and workspace reliability while keeping the qualified rc.5 core.
highlights: Windows ZIPs prepare the runtime to reduce first-launch work. Each startup retains its diagnostic history when the shared log is busy.
Portable menus, tray, updates, and maintenance follow the official language preference. Startup reads the official initial theme preference.
Fixes a missing conversation sidebar. The Windows taskbar and tray use a solid whale that follows the system color scheme.
Plugin discovery and management use the official interface. New environments no longer add a community index automatically, and existing indexes remain available.
Handles linked or busy files during maintenance and makes shared-file startup conflicts easier to diagnose.
upgradeNotes: Exit normally before updating. The package bundles DSH 0.2.1-rc.5. Core updates offer separately qualified versions.
To use the community plugin catalog, follow the README to add its index in the official Discover page.
acknowledgements: Thanks to [crazyrainman](https://github.com/WSL043/DSH-Portable/discussions/39#discussioncomment-19370243) for the icon feedback.
